description_en: Enables access logging for a cloud connector
description_zh: 指定云连接器开启访问日志功能
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc enable-iot-cloud-connector-access-log --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --access-log-sls-project sls-setter --access-log-sls-log-store test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableIoTCloudConnectorAccessLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The Log Service project that receives access logs
parameters.help_zh: 访问日志投递的日志项目
parameters.name: access_log_sls_project

parameters.help_en: The Logstore that receives access logs
parameters.help_zh: 访问日志投递的日志库
parameters.name: access_log_sls_log_store

parameters.help_en:
A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value on the client side. The value must be unique across requests and contain no more than 64 ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. Each API request may have a different RequestId
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run.

true: Performs a check. Does not enable access logging. Checks include required parameters, request format, and business limits. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.

false (default): Performs the operation. Returns an HTTP 2xx status code and enables access logging after passing the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会开启访问日志的功能。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接开启访问日志的功能
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the cloud connector instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
